Name: SREO - Sports Room Event Overhaul
Author: Galgana
Description:
[u][b]Features[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]removes marriage requirement for unlocking the saloon sports room
[*]makes Alex and Shane the primary NPC participants of Part 1 and Part 3
a previewable txt file is available for potential users to check out the dialogue contents[*]provides 2 methods of completing the sports room: [b]Donor Route[/b] (from the original 14-Heart Event) and [b]Miser Route[/b]
[*]these methods impact:
1) time elapse between Part 1 and Part 3
2) event dialogues with Shane and Alex (Part 1 - 2 lines; Part 3 - 2 lines)
3) prompt displayed in Part 2 message box
4) friendship points
[*][b]Donor Route[/b] exclusive event:
Part 4 reimburses money at a randomly-determined time after seeing Part 3[*]Immersive Scheduling:
Sunday meetups in the sports room occur [b]only[/b] when gridball season is active in [b]fall and winter[/b];NPC schedules on Sunday [b]revert[/b] to normal/pre-room activities during the off-season ([b]spring and summer[/b]);Affected NPCs: Alex, Shane, George, Kent, Gus.[/list]
[b]Configuration[/b]
[u]enableOverwriteAlex14H[/u] ([font=Courier New]default: true[/font])
[list]
[*]enables changes to Alex's 14-Heart Events (Parts 1, 2, 3) when [b][font=Courier New]true[/font][/b]
[*]disables changes to Alex's 14-Heart Events (Parts 1, 2, 3) when [b][font=Courier New]false[/font][/b]
[/list][u]requireHeartEvent[/u] ([font=Courier New]default: 8[/font])
[list]
[*]this value determines minimum hearts and the equivalent heart events required for triggering Part 1
[*]when set to [b]8[/b], the required events are: Alex 8-Heart Event @ beach, Shane 8-Heart Event @ Marnie's ranch
[*]when set to [b]10[/b], the required events are: Alex 10-Heart Event @ saloon, Shane 10-Heart Event @ bus stop
[/list][u]chanceDelivery[/u] ([font=Courier New]default: 0.1[/font])[list]
[*]this value determines the chance for triggering Part 2 through the [b]Miser Route[/b]
[*]this value also determines the chance for triggering Part 4 through the [b]Donor Route[/b]
[*]when all other conditions are met for an event:
value=0.1 indicates a 10% probability checkvalue=1 is 100% probability[/list]
[u][b]Compatibility[/b][/u][list]
[*]Shane's original 14-Heart Event @ town and saloon arcade room

SREO does not interact with these events[*]Mobile App: 14-Heart Events were added in Stardew Valley Version 1.4
SREO has not been tested on mobile editions of the game;
unknown compatibility
[*][[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4145]nexus[/url]﻿] [b]Tunnelling Ahead - A Post-Marriage Alex Expansion[/b]
adds new 14-Heart Events that change Alex's spouse schedule;edits to Sunday activities are carried over from this mod when the season is not spring(effectively, SREO interacts with its changes only in summer)[*][[url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/487802-immersive-characters-shane]moddrop[/url]﻿] [b]Immersive Characters - Shane[/b]
SREO should override this mod's changes in Part 3;[u]requireHeartEvent[/u]=[b]10[/b] is changed to the new Shane 10-Heart Event @ farm;no changes when value=[b]8[/b];no conflicting Sunday scheduling[*][[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5117]nexus[/url]﻿] [b]Immersive Spouses - Improved Spouse Schedules[/b]
during off-season Sundays, Alex and/or Shane will revert to this mod's pre-room spouse schedules[*][[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8146]nexus[/url]﻿] [b]Platonic Partners and Friendships[/b]
SREO should override this mod's changes[*][[url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/modpacks/8013-diverse-stardew-valley]moddrop[/url]﻿] [b]Diverse Stardew Valley[/b] (modpack)
I'm not aware of any conflicting event edits in this project's constituent mods.Recommended for its NPC options with disability representation[/list]
!SPOILERS! [u][b]Affected Event IDs and Conditions[/b][/u] !SPOILERS!

[u]PART 1
[/u][font=Courier New]3917587[/font]
[list]
[*]Year: 2+
[*]Season: Summer (gridball pre-season)
[*]Weather: Sunny
[*]Location: Farm
[*]Time: 6 AM - 9 AM
[*]money: 5000+
[/list][font=Courier New]giveAlexMoney[/font]
[list]
[*]initiates the [b]Donor Route[/b]
[/list]
[u]PART 2[/u]
[font=Courier New]3917589[/font]
[list]
[*]Day of Week: Sunday
[*]Season: Fall or Winter
[*]Location: Town
[/list][b]Donor Route[/b]: You decided to give the money
[list]
[*]initiates Part 3 as early as 7 Fall
[/list][b]Miser Route[/b]: You refused to give the money
[list]
[*]default configurable 10% chance to initiate any Sunday during Fall or Winter
[/list]
[u]PART 3
[/u][font=Courier New]3917590[/font]
[list]
[*]Location: Saloon
[/list]
[u]PART 4[/u] (add-on exclusive to [b]Donor Route[/b])
[font=Courier New]3917591[/font]
[list]
[*]Location: Farm
[*]default configurable 10% chance to receive mail returning the borrowed 5000g
[/list]
[b]Credits[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/70148453]Airyn[/url] for dialogue in [[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14212]nexus[/url]] [b]Fourteen Heart Events For All[/b] (Alt Shane and Vanilla Alex files), which became the inspiration of SREO's lines in Part 3 for Alex and Shane (and the text itself was mostly retained from this mod in the opening sentences of the two's character's mini-speeches. Kent's one line also was carried over into SREO). Some coding as provided by beyondrecovery was referenced as a template.
